whisper.title: Whisper large-v3-turbo (quantized)
whisper.note: Turns the recording into text in about 99 languages and detects the language by itself. Uses about 1 GB of memory while it works.

llm.title: Gemma 4 E4B
llm.note: The best tested: it found 12 of 13 key facts in our sample call and drafted a 30-minute call in under 3 minutes on a 16 GB Mac.

llm.title: Qwen 3.5 9B
llm.note: Found as many facts, but about twice as slow on a 30-minute call (5 minutes) and added two small details nobody said.

llm.title: Qwen 3.5 4B
llm.note: Small and fast, but it missed about a third of the facts and invented an out-of-scope item.

llm.title: Mistral Nemo 12B
llm.note: Reasonably fast, but its notes were thin: about 6 of 10 facts.

llm.title: Gemma 4 12B
llm.note: Too slow and too terse on a 16 GB Mac (about a third of the facts). Needs a computer with 24 GB of memory or more.
